newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end sharply up on blue chip buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end sharply up on blue chip buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended sharply up on buying of blue chips by retail investors taking positions ahead of annual meetings of some leading companies, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) rose 70.06 points or 3.19 percent at 2,263.86 on a turnover of 259.5 million taka. Of the 106 issues traded, 64 rose, 36 lost and six remained unchanged.
"Investors are optimistic about higher returns in the form of dividend and bonus. The expectation seems to keep the market strong for some more time," said one broker.
Apex Foods rose 1,483.68 taka to 17,104, Bangladesh Tobacco gained 21.65 at 348.33 and Square Pharma was up 163.21 at 1,795.
